lesson.text: Quick memory: in grade 5 you met synonyms and antonyms. What is an antonym of "ancient"? Modern, or new: the opposite meaning.
Words are related in patterns. Seeing the pattern helps you understand new words.
Part and whole: a page is part of a book; a wheel is part of a bike. Item and category: a sparrow is a kind of bird.
Cause and effect: rain causes floods; practice causes improvement. Synonyms and antonyms: the same and opposite meanings.
Analogies use these patterns: page is to book as petal is to flower (part to whole).
Try it in the world: make a word chain in your world with signs: seed, sapling, tree, forest. What is each link: part and whole, or cause and effect? Next: connotation.

exercises.prompt: A page is part of a book. A petal is part of a…
exercises.hint: Part and whole.
exercises.explain: A petal is part of a flower.

exercises.prompt: A sparrow is a kind of…
exercises.hint: Item and category.
exercises.explain: A sparrow is a kind of bird.

exercises.prompt: Rain can cause floods: that is cause and effect.
exercises.hint: Which comes first, the rain or the flood? Does one lead to the other?
exercises.explain: Yes: rain is the cause, floods the effect.

exercises.prompt: Which pair is part and whole?
exercises.hint: One is part of the other.
exercises.explain: A wheel is part of a bike.

exercises.prompt: Which pair are antonyms?
exercises.hint: Which pair means the opposite of each other?
exercises.explain: Early and late are opposites.

exercises.prompt: Complete: hot is to cold as up is to…
exercises.hint: Hot and cold are opposites. What is the opposite of up?
exercises.explain: Hot and cold are opposites, so up and down.

exercises.prompt: Complete: finger is to hand as toe is to…
exercises.hint: Part and whole.
exercises.explain: A toe is part of a foot.

exercises.prompt: What relationship do "hammer" and "tool" have?
exercises.hint: Is a hammer part of a tool, or one kind of tool?
exercises.explain: A hammer is a kind of tool.

exercises.prompt: "Chapter" and "book" are part and whole.
exercises.hint: A chapter is in a book.
exercises.explain: Yes: a chapter is part of a book.

exercises.prompt: Which pair shows cause and effect?
exercises.hint: One leads to the other.
exercises.explain: Practice leads to improvement.

exercises.prompt: Complete: author is to book as composer is to…
exercises.hint: Who makes what?
exercises.explain: An author writes books; a composer writes music.

exercises.prompt: Complete: seed is to tree as egg is to…
exercises.hint: What grows from it?
exercises.explain: A tree grows from a seed; a bird from an egg.

exercises.prompt: What relationship do "drought" and "thirst" have?
exercises.hint: Does one lead to the other?
exercises.explain: A drought causes thirst.

exercises.prompt: "Oak" and "tree" are antonyms.
exercises.hint: Is an oak the opposite of a tree?
exercises.explain: No: an oak is a kind of tree.

exercises.prompt: Complete: key is to lock as password is to…
exercises.hint: What does each one open?
exercises.explain: A key opens a lock; a password opens an account.

exercises.prompt: Sort the pairs by their relationship.
exercises.hint: Is one inside the other, one a kind of the other, or does one lead to the other?
exercises.explain: A petal and a chapter are parts of wholes. An oak and a trout are kinds of tree and fish. Practice and drought cause improvement and thirst.

exercises.prompt: Complete each analogy.
exercises.hint: Find the relationship in the first pair, then use the same one.
exercises.explain: A petal is part of a flower; up is the opposite of down; a composer makes music; a password opens an account.

exercises.prompt: Sort the pairs: synonyms or antonyms?
exercises.hint: Do the two words mean the same, or the opposite?
exercises.explain: Synonyms: big and large, quick and fast, glad and happy. Antonyms: early and late, ancient and modern, buy and sell.

exercises.prompt: Put the word chain in order, from the smallest to the biggest.
exercises.hint: Start with what is planted, then follow it as it grows.
exercises.explain: A seed grows into a sapling, the sapling into a tree (cause and effect), and many trees make a forest (part and whole).

exercises.prompt: Find the pattern in each first pair, then complete the analogy.
exercises.hint: Name the pattern in the first pair, then use the same pattern again.
exercises.explain: Part and whole: a page is part of a book. Item and category: an oak is a kind of tree. Cause and effect: practice causes improvement. Synonyms: quick means fast.

exercises.prompt: Sort the word pairs by their pattern.
exercises.hint: Ask: is one part of the other, a kind of the other, or its opposite?
exercises.explain: Part and whole: finger and hand, petal and flower. Item and category: a hammer is a tool, a trout is a fish. Opposites: up and down, early and late.

exercises.prompt: Match each word to the category it belongs to.
exercises.hint: Ask 'a sparrow is a kind of…' for each one.
exercises.explain: A sparrow is a kind of bird, an oak a kind of tree, a trout a kind of fish and a hammer a kind of tool: item and category.
